title: I'm making a cozy city builder where you build the North Pole
author: cozygridworks
selftext:
I'm making Build Christmas, a cozy city builder about growing an elf village and getting presents ready for Christmas Eve. You connect workshops into gift production chains and watch the elves carry goods around town. You can cover the village in Christmas lights, from the rooftops to the bridges and trains.

It started as a small 2D project about 6-8 months ago. I've been putting many hours into it every week since.

For the 3D version, I looked for an art style I could keep consistent through headless Blender/MCP workflows. Those became elaborate, with multiple review passes and critic agents checking the assets.

I love city builders and production games, so I've done a lot of playthroughs and made notes on what I'd expect as a player. Those notes led to economy adjustments and additions to the game. I worked on changes in isolated branches and merged them once I was satisfied with them.

As the models improved, I could take on bigger chunks of work. Deciding how the game feels to play still needs a human reviewer.

AI is used throughout development for code and visual assets, as well as written content and trailer narration. I review and refine the results. The game doesn't generate AI content while you play.

I can answer questions about the workflows or how the game came together.

[Build Christmas on Steam](https://store.steampowered.com/app/5332290/Build_Christmas/)
